label: local-isolated
method: Start an isolated Freenet gateway with blank HOME gateways.toml and --skip-load-from-network
Client A publishes one LXMF ciphertext entry via FreenetPropagationStore.put/update
Client B, with only the destination hash watched, pulls and finds the same transientId and ciphertext
notes: Same Freenet node holds contract state while TP client A is offline. This satisfies the F3 store exit criterion for local persistence; multi-Freenet-node retrieval remains optional evidence.
